title: Joins directly: badge and filter (depends on phase 6)
covers: GitHub topic archipelia-direct, badge Joins directly, filter, unlisted note
context: A world whose own game client speaks the lobby protocol can join a session from inside the game. Its repository carries the topic archipelia-direct. The card and the dialog show a Joins directly badge and the Games filter finds them. DEPENDS ON PHASE 6: this test cannot run until phase 6 is in the bundle.
changed: packages/catalog ready: reads archipelia-direct from the same search result as archipelia-world
views/GameStore: badge Joins directly on the card and in the dialog, a Joins directly filter

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: network
setup.text: Needed. The topics come from the GitHub search.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: world
setup.text: A repository with both topics archipelia-world and archipelia-direct and a stable release (Relic of the Past once RotP adds the topics). Without one, mark this test blocked.

steps: Open Library, Games, tab Archipelia ready. Find a world whose repository has the topic archipelia-direct. Its card shows the badge Joins directly. A world without the topic shows no such badge.
Press the title of that card. The dialog shows the same badge.
If the world is not reviewed (found by topic), the dialog says the host needs Allow unlisted clients so that players can join with its client.
Press Add filter and pick the field named Joins directly. Only the worlds with the badge stay in the list. Press Clear filters.
Open Sessions, pick a session with Allow direct connections on. If the setup lists which of its games join directly, a direct world is named there.
pass: The badge Joins directly shows on the card and in the dialog of a direct world, and on no other.
The filter keeps only the direct worlds and Clear filters brings the rest back.
A direct world that is not reviewed says the host must allow unlisted clients.
fail: The badge shows on a world with no archipelia-direct topic, or is missing on one that has it.
The filter keeps worlds without the badge.
notes: DEPENDS ON PHASE 6 (topic archipelia-direct). The badge text, the filter name and the setup hint follow the plan and are not on main yet. If the build has no Joins directly badge, mark this test blocked.
The topic is a hint only. The lobby protocol decides what a client can do when it connects.
Step 5 is optional: the setup hint is the least sure part of the plan.
